FZFG: Freezing fog (supercooled water droplets freezing on contact)
FZRA: Freezing rain (supercooled raindrops freezing on contact)
G/A: Ground-to-air (communication or signal from ground to aircraft)
GAIN: Airspeed or headwind gain (increase in indicated airspeed or headwind component)
GARP: GBAS azimuth reference point (reference point for GBAS azimuth guidance)
GES: Ground earth station (satellite communication ground terminal)
GLS: GBAS landing system (satellite-based precision approach and landing)
GNDCK: Ground check (pre-flight system verification on ground)
GPA: Glide path angle (vertical approach angle relative to horizontal)
GPIP: Glide path intercept point (point where aircraft intercepts the glide path)
GPU: Ground power unit (external electrical power supply for parked aircraft)
GRASS: Grass landing area (unpaved runway or landing surface)
GUND: Geoid undulation (difference between geoid and ellipsoid)
HBN: Hazard beacon (warning light marking an obstacle or hazard)
HCH: Heliport crossing height (height at which heliport threshold is crossed)
HDG: Heading (compass direction the aircraft nose points)
HGT: Height or height above (vertical distance above a reference)
HLDG: Holding (predetermined flight path for traffic sequencing)
HLS: Helicopter landing site (designated area for helicopter landing)
HOSP: Hospital aircraft (aircraft configured for medical evacuation)
HPA: Hectopascal (metric unit of atmospheric pressure, equivalent to millibar)
HRP: Heliport reference point (geographic reference point for a heliport)
HUD: Head-up display (transparent display projecting flight data in pilot's view)
HURCN: Hurricane (severe tropical cyclone with sustained high winds)
HX: No specific working hours (irregular or unspecified service times)
HYR: Higher ... (value or altitude exceeding a specified threshold)
HZ: Haze (suspended particles reducing visibility; also used for Hertz)
IAF: Initial approach fix (first navigation fix in an instrument approach)
IAO: In and out of clouds (intermittent cloud clearance during flight)
IAP: Instrument approach procedure (prescribed procedure for instrument landing)
IAR: Intersection of air routes (point where two airways or routes cross)
IAS: Indicated airspeed (airspeed read from the aircraft's pitot-static system)
IBN: Identification beacon (light or radio beacon for aircraft identification)
ICE: Icing (ice accretion on aircraft surfaces during flight)
ID: Identifier or identify (code or label for unique identification)
IFF: Identification friend/foe (electronic system for aircraft identification)
